title: Iran says third tanker hit sea mine near Hormuz; Indian seafarer missing, two hurt on LPG tanker
detail: Times of India reports an LPG tanker was targeted in the Strait of Hormuz, leaving one Indian seafarer missing and two injured. Iran says a third tanker has hit a sea mine near Hormuz. Details are from a single outlet and Iranian claims and are not independently verified; the vessel is unnamed here. Continued attacks raise freight, insurance and food/fertiliser import cost risks.

media.caption: Indian seafarers hurt, one missing after tanker targeted in Hormuz
